description: Source code for a Kubernetes API server admission plugin validator, implementing validation logic with CEL expressions, including decision making, error handling, and audit annotation processing.

classes.name: validator
classes.description: Implements the Validator interface for admission validation using CEL expressions.

methods.name: NewValidator
methods.description: Constructs a new validator instance with specified CEL filters, matcher, fail policy, and error state.

methods.name: policyDecisionActionForError
methods.description: Determines the action (admit or deny) based on the failure policy when an error occurs.

methods.name: auditAnnotationEvaluationForError
methods.description: Determines the audit annotation action (exclude or error) based on the failure policy when an error occurs.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Performs validation on admission requests, evaluating CEL expressions, and producing decisions and audit annotations.
